General-content county map showing municipalities, school districts (numbered), land survey sections (numbered), road section numbers, rural buildings, and rural householders' names.

General-content county map showing municipalities, school districts (numbered), land survey sections (numbered), road section numbers, rural buildings, and rural householders' names. Also shows radial distances from central Rochester city. Hand colored to emphasize municipal boundaries and school districts. "Copyrighted 1887, by J. B. Beers & Co." Printed in western/central/eastern segments (sheets). LC copy imperfect: Brittle, missing small sections in margins, torn, slightly water-stained, laminated, mounted on cloth backing, each sheet halved to enable folding, printed business-directory slip affixed to recto of western sheet, originally (before mounting) printed on 6 sheets, original sheets fold-lined. Includes notes, local business directories, and tabular index of places (indicating post-offices, money-order offices, telegraph stations, telephone stations, express offices), and advertisements.
